objections.claim: The donor registry stores one decision per repository, but the project charter says the default reuse unit is a narrow mechanism.
objections.evidence: The Anima audit already assigns different decisions to memory dynamics, heartbeat scheduling, self-model rewriting, and dream mining, while registry.json can encode only one top-level decision.
objections.disposition: Move decisions to component-level records and validate every component independently.

objections.claim: CI validates review files that happen to exist but does not prove every substantive change produced a review artifact.
objections.evidence: The workflow scans reviews/*.json without tying a review artifact to the current implementation revision.
objections.disposition: Document this bootstrap limitation now and add revision-aware review enforcement before cognitive integration begins.
